Reference / runtime/signal

runtime/signal#

The native layer under os/signal and web/app: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under os/signal and web/app: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Watches the named process signals, "TERM", "INT" or "HUP" (#80, #638).

Public API#

native signal_watch#

native signal_watch(names is @string) is int

Watches the named signals from now on without waiting (#638): a number for the calls below. The handlers stay until one of the signals comes or the watch is let go; then the signal gets its earlier action back, so a second one ends the process as usual.

native signal_arrived#

native signal_arrived(watch is int) is string

The name of the watched signal that came, or "" while none has.

native signal_unwatch#

native signal_unwatch(watch is int) is bool

Lets the watch go; again does nothing.

native signal_arrival#

native async signal_arrival(watch is int) is string

Waits until a watched signal comes; its name. Cancelling the wait keeps the watch.
